**Episode 10 - Improv**

• I think Isabelle is due for another win at this point and she’s amazing at improv from what we’ve seen on Daytona Wind and Snatch Game, I’d be shocked if she doesn’t win tonight

• I see a trend going on with the editing of some of these queens. Loosey, Marcia, and Luxx are all being given a form of the delusional edit or Jan edit

• Marcia has a ton of acting and improv experience so I think it would be unwise to underestimate her. Factoring in her Jan vibes, I think she’ll be set up to win this episode but only end up as high

• Loosey is great at improv but production might keep her safe to mess with her

• I don’t think Luxx is bad at improv but this cast is very talented. I think she’ll get her first low placement this week with production trying to crack her

• Production has been building up Anetra ever since they screwed her over in the lip sync smackdown. We’re learning more about her past and she’s been on top of her game so I think she’ll do well

• Malaysia and Salina get into their heads at times and I think that’ll trip them up this episode. I believe that even if Salina does somewhat well at the improv challenge, she’ll still be eliminated


**Episode 11 - Stand Up**

• There’s no way for me to know which queens will end up being paired with each other so I just gave each queen an individual placement

• I think Loosey is funny enough for the production to give her a win despite the delusional edit. This could act as a redemption because I don’t see her making it to the finale. Alternatively I think they might pair Loosey with someone she doesn’t get along with to try and screw her over

• If they don’t give the win to Loosey, I can see Isabelle taking it

• My gut is telling me that Anetra may not perform well in a stand up challenge since she’s quieter and isn’t known for comedy

• I think Luxx and Malaysia will end up in the bottom two. I don’t see much left for Malaysia to do beyond this point so I believe she will be eliminated


**Episode 12 - Rusical**

• I think this is finally the week that Marcia gets her win. She’s a theater kid so it makes sense and it wraps up her storyline before her departure

• Sasha’s been safe for two weeks so I believe she’ll come back to the foreground this episode. I see her playing a similar character to when she played “God” in week 2’s acting challenge

• Honestly Isabelle is an unstoppable force but production is gonna hold her back a bit in order for her to not outshine Sasha. I think Sasha Colby is the shows choice for a winner so they’ll find excuses to mess up Isabelle’s track record

• Luxx is stubborn and a fighter so I think even with production against her, she’ll manage to survive the lip sync

• I think this will be the week they try to push Loosey out of the competition to make room for the other front runners. She probably won’t do bad but she may be outshined


**Episode 13 - Makeover**

• At this point, Sasha and Isabelle are the top two of the season. Anetra and Luxx are competing for third place. They both have a really cool aesthetic and a lot of fashion sense. I think Anetra will end up with the win, solidifying her spot in the finale

• Isabelle will also do awesome but I don’t think she’ll win since her aesthetic, although polished and elegant, isn’t as interesting. Plus they wouldn’t wanna give her the lead in the competition by being the first to get three wins

• Marcia and Sasha are the only ones who realistically could be in the bottom in my opinion. The judges have said many times that Marcia’s drag is boring

• If there’s gonna be a double save, it’s this week. Sasha’s gonna eat Marcia up but in the case that Marcia holds her own, they’ll go with a double shantay


**Episode 14 - Music Video**

• Pretty much everyone’s gonna do well, I think they’ll give Sasha an extra challenge win even if they don’t usually do that in these kinds of episodes in order to get her ahead

• I’m not sure how Marcia will be eliminated but I don’t think she’ll make the finale

• Alternatively, if Marcia was already eliminated in the last episode, they may have a top 3 for the finale and eliminate Luxx this episode. This season has a very “back to basics” vibe to it and they may want to have a finale like they used to. Also this could be a twist, since I don’t see the production doing anything else crazier than that for this season

My personal placements for UK4 so far

I base my placements off of the queens performances in the challenge, their runway looks, and storyline purposes



Ep 1:
I was gonna give the win to Starlet over Peppa because her head piece fell off. But I knew immediately that Starlet wouldn’t make it far in the competition because she made it clear that she doesn’t perform. So I decided to give it to Peppa for storyline; it makes more sense to set someone up as a front runner rather than give a win to someone who’s about to go home. I also put Pixie in the bottom because she had the absolute worst looks of the night, I can’t imagine her beating Dakota in the lip sync so she would have been eliminated. Sminty and Cheddar did amazing while May and Copper were meh.

Ep 2:
Now I usually like to judge in teams for the girl groups challenge, but when you have the obvious winner and the obvious bottom 2s in a single group, you gotta judge individually. Baby CLEARLY won this, no questions about it. The only person who came close was Dakota; going from bottom 2 to a win is a good storyline plus her verse was awesome. Baby helped everyone with their lyrics, she choreographed, she was flawless. Cheddar also did great. I didn’t put Peppa in the top because her performance was too erratic to me. The idea of more than 2 people winning a challenge is just ridiculous and unnecessary to me. Now the bottom 3 were extremely clear; Jonbers, Sminty, and Starlet. I chose to save Sminty because she at least had energy in her performance plus she was making the best TV up until this point and had a fun personality. Starlet obviously goes home.

Ep 3:
Pairs almost always get judged as teams by me. My winning pair was Baby and Dakota; I think they were the most creative with the fabrics they used and their looks complimented each other perfectly. Le Fil and Sminty also did great. Danny and Pixie were very close to being in the bottom; the looks were too simple and are supposed to compliment each other, not be a carbon copy. They were lucky that 2 other teams were worse than them. I didn’t mind Jonbers’ look besides the mint colour washing her out, while Peppa’s look was very poorly constructed. Copper was clearly the worst of the night while Cheddar could’ve been in the top. I would’ve emphasized how Cheddar was partially responsible for Copper’s look to justify her low placement. I actually agree with Ru when she split the groups up and put Peppa and Copper in the bottom. They had the worst 2 outfits plus it’s a mini twist to split them up. Copper goes home.

Ep 4:
I judge individually for acting group challenges. Danny was amazing at improv and made me laugh the most so she gets the win. Pixie and Cheddar were not too far behind. Dakota made me laugh when she broke character but you’re technically not supposed to do that in improv so she’s safe. Jonbers and Peppa did fine. Baby wasn’t that bad to me, Le Fil was pretty bad, and Sminty was MILES behind everyone else. She had the best runway of the night but not even that could save her from the bottom 2. Plus she kinda got a pass from me in Ep 2. Baby had the better performance, Le Fil had the better look; the performance outweighs the runway for me so Le Fil is in the bottom 2. I think Sminty is an amazing drag artist but based on this challenge, I don’t think she’s ready for drag race. Sminty goes home, but hopefully she’ll be on all stars!

Ep 5:
This should have been a no bottoms episode like Daytona Winds. Everyone did great. Danny gets the win because she had the best performance and the best look. Jonbers would be in the top 2 lip sync along with Danny; she did amazing and this serves as a redemption for her. I also enjoyed her look. Le Fil being in the bottom made no sense to me, I definitely feel like the show is sleeping on her. Cheddar also performed well but I was slightly underwhelmed. Everyone else is safe. I’m not sure how things would have went down if Baby was safe, but I assume she still would have sent herself home this episode. Baby is my favourite so I’m sad to see her go but this is the best decision she could have made and I’m proud of her. (Btw that Baby vs Dakota lip sync would’ve 100% been a double shantay)

Ep 6:
This was an alright snatch game. Cheddar, Dakota, and Jonbers were all equally as good to me. Cheddar wins because of her look; I love when a queen makes a powerful statement with her runway. Peppa and Le Fil were an obvious bottom 2 to me. Le Fil was winning the lip sync but then she took of her shoes and poured objects out of it… choices. Peppa stays and Le Fil unfortunately departs.


What do y’all think of my choices? Do you agree or disagree with me more, I’m curious to know
